scope: Player/NPC/bot applied enemy-container damage-over-time (including arena), talent bleeds/Ignite, mana drain and leech; registered at application and dispatched through per-target readiness.

comparison.result: Every other snapshot field, including logs, RNG, resources, deaths and assets, matches the pre-change version

behaviorChanges: A recipient killed by an earlier same-time pulse receives no later pulse execution; pending damage effects on that dead recipient are retired
An already applied effect survives caster death while that caster remains part of the encounter, as before
Expired damage holders are removed at their effect boundary instead of filtering every enemy damage list every 100ms
limitations: The 75 snapshots do not prove all encounter time lines; death ordering has dedicated tests
Healing, enemy applied periodic auras, ground effects, aura expiry and out-of-combat persistent effects remain on their existing paths
Outer 100ms progression and unit/AI observation scans remain
Local benchmark uses Apple M4 with existing QA services present, three measured rounds after warmup, no PostgreSQL or real WebSocket and no capacity or speedup claim
Full browser matrix has not been rerun under this ruleset hash
